rationale.ai-review: Fine-tuned RuleChecker and ReviewFilter detect and validate code-review findings.
rationale.risk-routing: Precision and Outdated thresholds deactivate low-value rules before findings surface.
rationale.survey-input: Survey reports user value, rejection reasons, and requested review features.
rationale.framework: Reusable two-stage review pipeline plus feedback-driven data flywheel.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented and evaluated BitsAI-CR across supported languages.
rationale.adopted: Production deployment serves 12,000 weekly active ByteDance users.
rationale.metrics: Quality: Outdated Rate quantifies practical acceptance of automated review comments.
rationale.general-code: System reviews ordinary merge-request diffs, not specifically AI-generated code.
rationale.risk-security: Security vulnerabilities are a dedicated taxonomy and evaluated review dimension.
rationale.risk-quality: System detects defects, maintainability, readability, and performance issues.
rationale.method-self-report: User survey and structured interviews gathered practitioner assessments.
rationale.method-mining: Mined internal review comments and production modification telemetry.
rationale.method-field-study: Production deployment tracked precision, retention, and acceptance over weeks.
